title: Flygon Begon
description: This add-on adds a Female Flygon variant and a Male Mega Flygon.
body:
Ever thought to yourself that maybe Flygon DOES deserve a mega well this is my interpritation also adding a female variant to give it more love plus more realism.
Adds Flygon Variants including a:
Female Form (Larger, a bit state beefier, can't fly)
A Male Mega Form (Bug/Dragon)
A Female Mega Form (Not yet implimented)

Mega stone recipe:
In a smithing table: a dragon fang, mega stone, and a bug gem.
